content: Kielienne Gonjiku
Mii gaijiulaya, ta olon kunla man loushi danlane bu gie. Loushi danlasan kunyi psedu kunlase gundude panjikui ta mejiene.
Matan dajiala go fanmiende cowu fanjine. Nie kun kielien jiere yama cowu ulie fanjise hheshi hulun kun wo. Goya hunshenne man kunzhi gie shidane.
Matan moreii amande ghada teizhi hhei hanshiliese hunshenyini kunzhi giene.
Pse chonni nie sumula, hhe fugie woma, honfen kei eghizhi chonni gojiolughaliuzhe siji niekozi ga banbaghala fanxianyi goyane isighala suibiende zhanwo giene.
Kielienye niekielien wo. Beye jieredu nie ga iyanzi woma, fugie kielien kielie shidane. Uzhe, zui gaji khanliuzhe nie linkoni sideragha shidane.
Kielienshi khan wo. Nie gou witu duya wo. Mai beye jiere teidene hunshenni zannanshighane. Dozoheini khanghala mai shenholai man sideraghane.
Kun yanyanji yewo, bunzhu, ghughei, zhaghasunlai hanshilie shidane, ede ijin hanshiliezho.
Zinie goya kielienne hanshilie dane. Kielienshi ulie beiku doghunni wo, alaku du duruzho.
Hheghala matan Ezhan, Adani doulazho. Pse hheghala Hudai yanzighala zhayaghasan kunyi kharazho.
Doulaku, kharaku nie amanse khizhezho. Mii gaijiula, ene ese oluzho.
Nie bula nudunse qien usu, kou usu khizhe shidanu?
Mii gaijiula, uhuago mutun jiere ganlan alima sou shidanu? Putou mutun jiere uhuago sou shidanu? Sou dane, kou bulase qien usu khizhe daku niekielien wo.
Hudase Iresan Agheli
Tai dunda kiende agheli, jienzha wine? Hhe kun aghelise iresan renyitu zhugheghala goude giezhi kunlade zhenmin gie.
Tai zhughede hende dubilieku, zisitu zhughe bise goyane bu tungulie. Ghudanghala zhendaoni fandui bu gie.
Ene aghelishi asiman jierese iresan pusho. Duya, nefuxin, sheitanse iresan wo.
Jien dubilieku sunsigheilieku winetu oronde londaku, yanyanji doghunni gieku shiqin wine.
Zinie asiman jierese iresan aghelishi xien ganjinni wo. Pse heqi, renyi, ranji, olon ubali xiizhi gounii gie, pienxin ulie gie, jiani wikui wo.
Heqishighachen kunla heqini tareidene gundanni ghurane.
